shadows.name: portrait-offset
shadows.purpose: Physical-print effect for the personal portrait only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action on neutral surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-text-inverse); font:700 15px var(--font-body); transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 140ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-highlight); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Highlight Button
components.description: High-contrast action for cobalt or ink surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-highlight { min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-highlight); color:var(--color-text-primary); font:700 15px var(--font-body); transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-highlight:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-highlight:focus-visible { outline:3px solid white; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Technology Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:28px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-bg-tertiary); color:var(--color-text-secondary); font:650 13px var(--font-body); }

components.name: Project Mark
components.description: A compact two-letter identity for every project row.
components.css: .ds-project-mark { display:grid; width:54px; height:54px; place-items:center; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-text-inverse); font:780 16px var(--font-heading); }

components.name: Navigation Mark
components.description: The compact NK monogram used in the fixed navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-mark { display:grid; width:31px; height:31px; place-items:center; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-text-inverse); font:780 12px var(--font-heading); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-mark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-highlight); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The site should feel like a well-used kit assembled by someone who understands the job: a clean working surface, clear labels, bright markers, and no ornamental parts. It is expressive through decisive scale and color, but every visual move still has a practical role.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast cobalt and lime used as confident working colors.
Large, compressed display type paired with a highly legible body face.
Ruled lists and asymmetric compositions in place of repetitive cards.
Personal details presented as evidence, not decoration.
Responsive layouts that become linear and calm on small screens.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Lime marks a decision or a live status. It is never used as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The No Gradient Rule
rules.body: All colors are solid. Gradients are prohibited throughout the interface.

rules.name: The One Loud Sentence Rule
rules.body: Every viewport may have one dominant typographic idea. Supporting text stays deliberately quieter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and sections do not float. If a surface has both a visible border and a soft shadow, the treatment is wrong.

dos: Do use signal cobalt for decisive surfaces and highlighter lime for actions or live status.
Do keep body copy within 65 to 75 characters per line.
Do let project facts and maintained status provide credibility.
Do use asymmetric spacing and full-width ruled lists to keep the composition human.
Do respect reduced-motion settings and preserve visible content without JavaScript.
donts: Don't create generic dark developer portfolios, neon gradients, floating blobs, or glass cards.
Don't use emoji placeholders, generic card grids, startup slogans, or inflated expertise claims.
Don't hide the role of AI in the work or turn it into a novelty badge.
Don't use gradient text, rounded cards over 14px, or repeated uppercase section eyebrows.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide soft shadow on the same component.
